input.quote: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction
input.rationale: Customer may assign to affiliates and M&A successors without consent, other assignments require consent that may not be unreasonably withheld, and there is no Vendor termination or re-pricing right on Customer's change of control. This meets the preferred position on its material terms; we note only that Kubient's free assignment right is not restricted from transfers to a Customer competitor.
